name: Universal Basic Guys
description: Two brothers lose their jobs to automation and are given $3,000 a month in a new basic income program, allowing them to use their free time and free money to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

videos.title: Pet Projects (Pilot)
videos.overview: Threatened by a doctor's kindness toward Tammy, Mark tries to get her an exotic animal, only to have his face ripped off by the newly purchased chimpanzee. Meanwhile, Hank bonds with the chimpanzee via its bluetooth, and David's dog saves David and Mernft Man from a pet snake.

videos.title: Sunset Cruise
videos.overview: When David, Andrea, Mark, and Tammy go on a cruise together, David and Andrea unexpectedly rekindle their romance. Mark's preoccupation with reeling in a big fish to outcompete Steve DelVecchio leads to him catching a whale that jeopardizes the safety of the entire cruise. Meanwhile, Hank goes on a date with a mermaid that goes awry when she reveals her distaste for hot dogs.

videos.title: The Devil You Know
videos.overview: Mark, in an attempt to bond with his stepson Darren, insists on teaching him how to throw a handmade boomerang that was gifted to Darren by his father. The two soon find themselves on a trek deep into the Jersey woods in search of it, where they encounter the Jersey Devil himself. Meanwhile, David is the recipient of a sex doll that he swears he didn't order, and is put through the wringer trying to return it.

videos.title: Guys Day
videos.overview: When Tammy is upset that an elite country club only takes men, Mark joins it to supposedly change things from within; Tammy's passion for the club infuriates the owner's wife, Ellen; Mark's entry into the club ruins the natural order.

videos.title: Jaws of Life
videos.overview: Jealous of the attention Tammy gets for saving the life of a choking stranger, Mark buys a Jaws of Life to efficiently save lives; Tammy's life is threatened when she rejects the advances of Paul, the stranger she saved.

videos.title: Bird Cage
videos.overview: Mark buys himself a Superbowl ring and leverages it to get special treatment at the Eagles game; Hank has an adventure with cutting-edge mascot technology.

videos.title: Fight or Flight
videos.overview: Mark puts his piloting skills to the test.

videos.title: Poconos
videos.overview: Mark, Tammy, Hank, and Darren discover a magical, immersive, Jumani-style board game where they have to overcome their interpersonal differences in order to survive. David, facing the most important deadline and worst writer's block of his career, seeks solitude.

videos.title: Mr. Cupcake Man
videos.overview: Mark, trying to prove to Tammy that he can get babies to like him, writes a hit song that becomes the next Baby Shark. He enlists his family and neighbors to join his management team, putting these relationships to the test during his meteoric rise and humiliating fall. Meanwhile, David tries to capitalize in Mark's wake by resuscitating his old and out of touch climate change educational magic act.

videos.title: Mark Men
videos.overview: Mark throws his hat into the ring as an Ad Man after being shown up by a group of execs.

videos.title: Sheet Shock
videos.overview: After feeling slighted by a Navy recruiter, Mark sets out to join an elite unit of the Marines, only to be thwarted by his inability to properly make a bed. David teams up with a Veteran, hoping to ghost write the next American Sniper and can no longer distinguish fantasy from reality as his subject reveals stories from his past that are stranger than fiction.

videos.title: Deer Stakes
videos.overview: Mark accidentally murders Hank with a crossbow while hunting a deer.

videos.title: Water Ice Shoppe
videos.overview: Mark goes into business with Gary & Barry's Water Ice Shoppe, a Glantontown institution, when faced with being deprived of his favorite summer snack during their annual winter closure.

videos.title: The Goofballs
videos.overview: Darren shows interest in playing hockey. Mark creates a team for him.

videos.title: I Am Jar
videos.overview: Mark gets in a magician's duel. Tammy tries to win a nursing award.

videos.title: Golden Beans
videos.overview: Mark and David start a coffee shop in the garage. Tammy and Hank struggle to keep Mernft Man from bothering customers.

videos.title: Down the Shore
videos.overview: The Hoagies go down the shore.

videos.title: Well Done
videos.overview: Mark digs a well.

videos.title: Hoagie Jones
videos.overview: Mark and Hank buy a horse together. Tammy invests in a painting.

videos.title: Medieval Knights
videos.overview: Mark goes medieval in an effort to bond with Darren. Tammy and Andrea test-drive an autonomous car.

videos.title: Spectrum Slam
videos.overview: Mark trains to win a charity basketball tournament, and David tries to find a teammate.

videos.title: Machine Yearning
videos.overview: Mark and Tammy discover Darren's first girlfriend is actually AI. They both struggle with the new technology.

videos.title: Good Marks
videos.overview: Mark goes back to high school to prove he is smart. Hank tries to pass Advanced Woodshop.

videos.title: Two Marks
videos.overview: Mark enrolls in a dangerous science experiment to win a Super Bowl ticket.

videos.title: Skyboys
videos.overview: Mark buys a jetpack. David wants to serve omakase at a soup kitchen.

videos.title: Little the Netherlands
videos.overview: Mark learns to ride a bike and finds a hidden Dutch enclave; Tammy helps Leanne plan her "divorce-lorette" party.

videos.title: Shorty Hoagies
videos.overview: Mark and Tammy get adventurous on a date night at the Philadelphia Flower Show. Darren and JD prank David.

videos.title: Go Fund Mernft
videos.overview: Mark helps Mernft Man build the house of his dreams, while Tammy's fundraising campaign reveals a surprising side of Mernft.

videos.title: That Dog in You
videos.overview: Mark trains Hank to become a professional eater. Tammy joins Darren's video game squad.

videos.title: Markumentary
videos.overview: Mark wants to be the star of David's UBI documentary.

videos.title: Crowmaster
videos.overview: Mark trains crows to bring him valuable sports cards and Darren faces off with a gaming nemesis.
